projects.reason: Set the vocabulary for structured state in Flutter; its patterns shaped how a generation of production apps are architected.
Widely recommended for compile-safe, testable state — and a frequent reference point in community architecture discussions.
The first recommended approach to app state, and the foundation many later libraries built on.
The most-starred Dart networking library, and the default HTTP layer in countless apps.
From first release to a top UI kit in under two years, with steady releases.
A public reference for what high-craft, motion-rich Flutter UI can look like.
Made multi-package Dart repositories practical, and is now standard in large monorepos.
Turned complex effect choreography into a readable, chainable API.
Brought over-the-air code push to compiled Flutter apps — previously thought impractical.
Actively developed since 2017 — older than Flutter 1.0 itself.
The most-liked package on pub.dev, bundling state, routing and dependency injection in one API.
Made immutable data classes and unions routine in Dart.
The default JSON code generator for Dart since the Dart 2 era.
Grew from a community package into Flutter's recommended router.
On pub.dev since 2015, before Flutter's first alpha, and still a staple of reactive Dart.
Brought React-style hooks to Flutter widgets.
One of the most-liked plugins on pub.dev, and the standard way to schedule local notifications.
The standard way to load and cache network images since 2017.
The go-to swipe-action list item, liked by thousands of developers.
Comprehensive Material theming, from a single seed color to every component.
Made calling the Windows API from Dart practical, with millions of downloads.
Template-based code generation used across the ecosystem.
A fast, minimalist backend framework that made Dart on the server approachable.
An open-source, cross-platform AirDrop alternative and one of the most-starred Flutter apps.
An open-source Notion alternative built on Flutter, with tens of thousands of stars.
The leading self-hosted photo library, with a Flutter mobile app.
An open-source remote desktop whose cross-platform UI is Flutter.
The canonical curated list of Flutter libraries, tools and tutorials.
An open-source music client showing Flutter on every desktop and mobile platform.
